thought.text: Menarik — **semua 28 model mengisi `content`** dengan `max_tokens: 400`. Jadi dugaan saya sebelumnya salah. Saya cek kenapa tadi kosong.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && K="nmk_live_g1r1I3MMlZDJaclmlAFylupkQulRriMVhSaVx3xR"; for mt in 10 30 60 120 400; do printf "max_tokens=%-4s " "$mt"; curl -s --max-time 90 -X POST "https://api.nomask.ai/v1/chat/completions" -H "Authorization: Bearer $K" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"model\":\"deepseek_v4.1_flash_1017_uncensored\",\"messages\":[{\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"Say exactly: HALO\"}],\"max_tokens\":$mt,\"force_string_serializer\":true}" | python3 -c "
import sys,json
d=json.load(sys.stdin);m=d['choices'][0]['message']
print(f\"content={len((m.get('content') or '').strip())} reasoning={len((m.get('reasoning_content') or '').strip())} tok={d.get('usage',{}).get('completion_tokens')} finish={d['choices'][0]['finish_reason']}\")
"; done
